description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns content-change signals for any public URL: ETag, Last-Modified, Content-Length, and Content-Type via HTTP HEAD. Falls back to GET + SHA-256 of the first 32 KB when the server returns no cache markers. Store the snapshot and re-call periodically to detect changes. Useful for monitoring competitor pricing, news, regulatory filings, or any public page.

url.description: HTTPS or HTTP URL to poll. Must be a publicly accessible endpoint.

name: web-change-monitor

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of first 32 KB of body — only populated when ETag and Last-Modified are both absent.

etag.description: ETag header value if returned by the server.

last_modified.description: Last-Modified header value if returned by the server.

method_used.description: "HEAD" (preferred) or "GET" (fallback when HEAD yields no change markers).

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the server.
